{
  "name": "pstack",
  "displayName": "pstack",
  "version": "0.15.15+claude.7",
  "description": "poteto's rigorous engineering skills (poteto-mode, how/why, architect, verification), ported from Cursor and kept in sync with upstream",
  "author": {
    "name": "PickleBoxer"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/PickleBoxer/pstack",
  "repository": "https://github.com/PickleBoxer/pstack",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "pstack",
    "poteto-mode",
    "skills",
    "workflow",
    "principles",
    "subagents",
    "verification"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "search_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Search model",
      "description": "Model for pstack read-only searches and the recall fan-out",
      "options": [
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus",
        "fable",
        "inherit"
      ],
      "default": "haiku"
    },
    "code_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Code model",
      "description": "Model for pstack code delegates (upstream uses Grok here)",
      "options": [
        "sonnet",
        "opus",
        "fable",
        "haiku",
        "inherit"
      ],
      "default": "sonnet"
    },
    "judgment_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Judgment model",
      "description": "Model for pstack judgment, prose and the hardest changes (upstream uses Opus)",
      "options": [
        "opus",
        "fable",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku",
        "inherit"
      ],
      "default": "opus"
    },
    "poteto_default": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Poteto mode on by default",
      "description": "Start new projects with /poteto mode pinned",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
